## Description {#details}

<p>C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ deferred reporter.</p>


<p>This header provides the two deferred-reporter classes used by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">expect()</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">assume()</span> to capture a test-expression result and report the outcome only when the reporter object is destroyed (i.e. at the semicolon following the expression statement), after the optional user message was appended.</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li><span class="doxyComputerOutput">deferred_reporter_base</span> stores the boolean result, the source location, an optional user-supplied message (accumulated via <span class="doxyComputerOutput">operator&lt;&lt;</span>), and a reference to the owning <span class="doxyComputerOutput">subtest</span>. Its destructor calls the reporter to emit a pass or fail line.</li>
<li><span class="doxyComputerOutput">deferred_reporter</span> derives from the base; its template constructor formats the expression (with the actual operand values) into the expression formatter of the reporter, so that it can be printed on failure.</li>
</ul>

<p>Both classes live in the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">detail</span> namespace and are not part of the public API.</p>


<p>This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.</p>
